create_EpisodicLoggerConfig: create an EpisodicLoggerConfig dataclass with agent_id, task_id, output_directory, and observation specs
create_EpisodicLogger: create an EpisodicLogger instance using EpisodicLogger.create with a config to log robotics episodes to MCAP
reset_EpisodicLogger: reset the EpisodicLogger with a starting dm_env.TimeStep to begin recording a new episode
record_action_and_next_timestep: record an action and resulting timestep with policy_extra into the EpisodicLogger batch buffer
write_EpisodicLogger: write the current episode data to disk as MCAP and finalize the episode session
